from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc2')
# try a few crafted UTF-8 inputs around punycode/label boundaries
cands=[b'xn--', b'xn--a', b'xn--a.', b'xn--a..', b'xn--\xff', b'\xc3\xa9', b'\xe2\x80\x8d', b'a'*64+b'.'+b'b'*64+b'.'+b'c'*64]
for i,c in enumerate(cands):
    q=Path(f'/workspace/poc_{i}')
    q.write_bytes(c)

PY
for f in /workspace/poc_*; do echo "== $f =="; bash /workspace/submit.sh "$f" /workspace/candidate_trace.json | tail -n 3; done
